title: Callander Meadows Walk Route

images.title: Kayakers at the Meadows, Callander by Sheila Winstone, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Kayakers at the Meadows, Callander

description: This short circular walk takes you around the Callander Meadows in the Scottish Highlands. Start off from the Meadows car park on the western side of the town and then pick up the pleasant footpath running along the river and through the meadows. The route offers lovely views of the surrounding hills, with the River Teith providing a scenic backdrop as you make your way around the meadows. The walk is generally easy to follow and makes a pleasant way to explore the countryside around Callander. Along the way you can enjoy views towards Ben Ledi and the Trossachs, before returning to the car park.  *meadows walk
